# Card

> A plate that holds one thing together, like a summary, a setting or a figure. Filled grey, or just an edge.

## Install

It lands in `src/rost/card/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/card.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | enum | `filled` `outlined` | `filled` |
| `children` | slot |  |  |

## Anatomy

- `root`: A `<div>`, or a `<section>` with `as` when it has a heading of its own. It lays its children out in a column, 16px apart.

## When to use

- **Things that belong together.** A month's totals, one setting with its explanation, a client's details: one card each.
- **On grey.** Inside a panel that's grey already, `outlined` keeps the edge without stacking grey on grey.

## When not to use

- **Something to click.** A whole card that's a link. That's **Thumbs**, which has hover, press and focus.
- **Rows of data.** Rows you compare. That's **Table**.
- **Cards in cards.** One card inside another. Use spacing and a heading instead.

## Behaviour

A plate with 24px inside it and 16px between what it holds. It doesn't do anything: no hover, no press. The edge on `outlined` is decoration, so it doesn't need 3:1 against the page; what's in the card has to carry itself.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: A `<div>` by default. Make it a `<section>` with an `aria-labelledby` pointing at its heading when it's a part of the page someone would jump to.
- **Colour**: The filled plate is #171717 on the dark page. Text on it uses the same tokens as on the page and keeps AA.

## Content

A heading, if it needs one, in sentence case. Keep it to one idea.
